questions.stem: Coronary blood flow to the left ventricle increases during

options.label: D
options.text: Stimulation of sympathetic nerves to the heart.

issueNotes: D: Sympathetic stimulation has competing direct alpha-adrenergic vasoconstrictor and beta/metabolic vasodilator influences. Overall flow often rises when cardiac work rises; the statement lacks the required context.
E: Arterial pressure alone does not invariably increase coronary flow because coronary autoregulation changes resistance. This depends on the perfusion pressure and autoregulatory range.
